== Notes ==
* Unlike [[Grenth's Grasp]], Assassin's Remedy does not require you to hit with an attack skill.
* Conditions are removed before the attack skill connects.  This is useful for preventing [[blind]] from stopping your combo. This means the enchantment will be removed before your last attack skill hits.
{{anomaly|Using a [[pet attack]] while enchanted with Assassin's Remedy doesn't remove a condition, unlike [[Zealous Anthem]] and [[Anthem of Fury]].}}
